bilo: biti — to be; bilo gde — anywhere, bilo koji — any
da: conjunction: that, so that; da + verb = infinitive («da vidim» — to see); also «yes»
dosta: adverb: quite a lot; dosta dobro — quite good
ga: short form of njega; «ili ti ga» — «or, in other words» (colloquial)
gde: gde si — hi, how are you (colloquial)
gradska: gradski — city; acc. case pl. neut.
grmelo: grmeti — to thunder; past neut. sg.
i: conjunction; before the word — «and, also, even»
ima: imati — to have; ima = «there is, there exists»
istinita: istinit — true; nom. case fem. sg.
izgledala: izgledati — to look; bi izgledala — would look
je: biti — to be, 3rd pers. sg.; auxiliary verb past; je l' — «really, or what»
kući: kuća — house; idemo kući — we're driving home
maknula: maknuti — to remove; past fem. sg.
modra: modar — blue; nom. case fem. sg.
mogao: moći — to be able; past, masc.
može: moći — to be able; 3rd pers. sg.; «može» — «all right, it's okay»
na: preposition: na jugu — in the south, na Instagram — in Instagram
nađe: will turn out, will be found
ni: nije čak ni selo — this is not even a village
nije: negation of je: nije selo — this is not a village
nisam: negation of auxiliary verba, 1st pers. sg.
ništa: at the beginning of a sentence — «well then, anyway»
osim: preposition + gen. case; osim što — besides the fact that
oženi: oženiti se — to marry (of a man); 3rd pers. sg.
pljuštala: pljuštati — to pour down; past fem. sg.
po: po mraku — in the dark; po jedan — one by one; dva i po — two and a half
preko: preposition + gen. case: preko reke — beyond the river; preko puta — opposite
prekrila: prekriti — to cover; past fem. sg.
prelivala: prelivati se — to shimmer, to flow over; past, pl. neut.
princ: Princ Rupertova kapljica — Prince Rupert's drop
putovao: putovati — to travel; past masc. sg.
sa: preposition + instr. case; + gen. case — «with, from» (sa mape — from the map)
sam: biti, 1st pers. sg.: rekao sam — I said; also «myself»: sam sebi — to oneself
se: reflexive particle: slikamo se — we take photos of ourselves
sevalo: sevati — to flash (lightning); past neut. sg.
slivala: slivati se — to flow down; past fem. sg.
spavala: spavati — to sleep; past fem. sg.
spavaću: spavaći — sleeping; acc. case fem. sg.
stajala: stajati (nekome) — to go, to suit; lepo ti stoji — it suits you
stavljeno: staviti — to put; passive participle neut.
su: biti, 3rd pers. pl.: sela su — villages — this…
sva: sav — all; sva sela — all the villages; sva sreća — fortunately
tome: to; loc. case: po tome što — by the fact that
treba: trebati — to be needed; treba ti — you need
tvrdom: tvrd — hard; loc. case neut. sg.
u: preposition: + loc. case — where, + acc. case — where to
ujutru: u šest ujutru — at six in the morning
ukrao: ukrasti — to steal; past masc. sg.
za: preposition: za to — for this; skretanje za — turn onto
zakucao: zakucati — to knock; past masc. sg.
zna: znati — to know; zna da bude — it happens
znali: znati; past, pl.; «Erste Znali» — website name
što: conjunction «what»; colloquial question «of what, why» (što si se sredio?)
